select ts.id, ts.task_id, ti.task_name, ci.cluster_name, ti.engine_type, ts.schedule_name, ts.schedule_status, ts.schedule_frequency, ts.create_time, ts.update_time, ts.is_deleted from task_schedule ts left join task_info ti on ti.id = ts.task_id left join cluster_info ci on ci.id = ti.cluster_id
ts.is_deleted = 0
and ti.task_name = CONCAT('%', #{params.taskName}, '%')
and ti.engine_type = #{params.engineType}
and ci.cluster_name like CONCAT('%', #{params.clusterName}, '%')
and ts.schedule_name like CONCAT('%', #{params.scheduleName}, '%')
and ts.schedule_status = #{params.scheduleStatus}
order by ts.update_time
